title: AHFC Board Confirms Key Leadership
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) board convened a brief meeting.
*   Will Wynn was appointed as the new President of the AHFC Board of Directors.
*   Several key officers, including the General Manager, Treasurer, and General Counsel, were re-appointed to their roles, with terms set to expire in June 2006.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, July 17,2003
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, July 17, 2003, in the Hancock Building Board Room of the Lower Colorado River
Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. The following were the AHFC items considered by the Austin
Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
President Wynn called the meeting to order at 3:53 p.m.
AHFC- I 
Approve tlic minutes of the June 12, 2003 Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
June 12, 2003 were approved on Board Member Dunkerley's motion. President
Wynn's second on a 4-0 vote. Vice President Goodman and Board Members
McCracken and Thomas were off the dais.
AHFC- 2 
Approve the appointment of Will Wynn as President of the Board of Directors and the
re-appointment of Toby Hammett Futrell as the General Manager, Paul Hilgers as
Treasurer, Sedora Jefferson as the General Counsel, Shirley A. Brown as the Secretary
and Yvonne Spence as Assistant Secretary of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation
for terms expiring on the earlier to occur of the date the officer is no longer an officer or
employee of the City of Austin, or June 15, 2006.
The motion authorizing the appointment of Will Wynn as President of the Board of
Directors and the re-appointment of Toby Hammett Futrell as the General
Manager, Paul Hilgers as Treasurer, Sedora Jefferson as the General Counsel,
Shirley A. Brown as the Secretary and Yvonne Spence as Assistant Secretary was
approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board Member Dunkerlcy's
second on a 7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:54 p.m.
